appDescription.message: Tool factory in the browser: build custom tools, at zero cost per use.

topMessage.message: You can build any tool you want

homeSubheader.message: No code. No subscriptions. Just tell it what you need.

wizardStepBasicsSubtitle.message: A short name and description. This is what you'll see later.

wizardStepChatSubtitle.message: Chat with the builder to bring it to life.

wizardDescriptionPlaceholder.message: e.g. Extract all links from the current page

wizardTriggerManualDescription.message: Runs only when you click it. No page needed, e.g. summarize a document.

wizardTriggerStartDescription.message: Starts right away, before the page finishes loading.

wizardTriggerIdleDescription.message: Waits until the page has fully loaded, e.g. to read its content.

wizardScopeEverywhereDescription.message: Runs on any site you visit.

wizardScopeDomainDescription.message: Runs only where you allow it.

wizardScopeTargetsPlaceholder.message:
One per line, e.g.
example.com
example.com/path

wizardBasicsRequiredError.message: Fill in both the name and the description before continuing.

wizardScopeRequiredError.message: Enter at least one domain or page before continuing.

userScriptsDisabledDescription.message: Open chrome://extensions, find this extension, and turn on "Allow User Scripts" to let your tools run.
